# vergeio_site (Resource)

`vergeio_site` is a remote VergeOS system this one pairs with. `name` and `url` are required.

`auth_password_wo` is sent when the site is created and when `auth_password_wo_version` changes. Terraform stores the version, not the password. On create those values are the pairing user and password. On a later change they are sent as the remote user and remote password.

Create does not ask VergeOS to build syncs. Declare [`vergeio_site_sync_incoming`](site_sync_incoming.html) and [`vergeio_site_sync_outgoing`](site_sync_outgoing.html) for the syncs you want. Cloud snapshots use [`vergeio_snapshot_profile`](snapshot_profile.html). VergeOS uses that same profile for VMs, volumes, and cloud snapshots.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A remote VergeOS system. Create does not build syncs.
# auth_password_wo is sent on create and when the version changes.
# Terraform stores the version, not the password.

resource "vergeio_site" "example" {
  name        = "Remote Lab"
  url         = "https://203.0.113.10"
  description = "Paired system in the other building"
  city        = "Austin"
  enabled     = false

  config_cloud_snapshots = "disabled"

  auth_user                = "sync"
  auth_password_wo         = "example-password"
  auth_password_wo_version = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Site name. Must be unique.
- `url` (String) URL of the remote VergeOS system.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `allow_insecure` (Boolean) Allow a TLS certificate VergeOS would otherwise reject. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.
- `auth_password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Password sent when the site is created and when auth_password_wo_version changes. Terraform does not store it. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11.
- `auth_password_wo_version` (Number) Version of auth_password_wo. Increment it to send a new password. Terraform stores this number, not the password.
- `auth_user` (String) User sent when the site is created, and sent as the remote user when auth_password_wo_version changes. VergeOS does not return it. Omit to leave the stored value unchanged.
- `city` (String) City shown for this site. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.
- `config_cloud_snapshots` (String) Cloud snapshot direction: disabled, send, receive, or both. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.
- `config_management` (String) Management direction: disabled, manage, managed, or both. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.
- `config_repair_server` (String) Repair server direction: disabled, send, receive, or both. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.
- `config_statistics` (String) Statistics direction: disabled, send, receive, or both. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.
- `country` (String) Two letter country code, or empty. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.
- `description` (String) What this site is for. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.
- `domain` (String) DNS domain of the remote system. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the site connection is enabled. Defaults to true.
- `latitude` (Number) Latitude from -90 through 90. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.
- `longitude` (Number) Longitude from -180 through 180. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.
- `request_url` (String) URL the remote system uses to connect back. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.
- `statistics_interval` (Number) Seconds between statistics collections. Minimum 300. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.
- `statistics_retention` (Number) Seconds to keep collected statistics. Minimum 1. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.
- `timezone` (String) Timezone name, such as America/Chicago. Omit to leave the current value unchanged.

### Read-Only

- `authentication_status` (String) Whether the site is authenticated.
- `created` (Number) Time the site was created, as seconds since the epoch.
- `creator` (String) User that created the site.
- `id` (String) Site key assigned by VergeOS.
- `incoming_management_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the remote system can manage this system.
- `incoming_stats_enabled` (Boolean) Whether incoming statistics are enabled.
- `incoming_syncs_enabled` (Boolean) Whether incoming syncs are enabled on this site.
- `is_tenant` (Boolean) Whether the remote system is a tenant.
- `last_stat_update` (Number) Time statistics were last updated, as seconds since the epoch.
- `modified` (Number) Time the site was last modified, as seconds since the epoch.
- `outgoing_management_enabled` (Boolean) Whether this system can manage the remote system.
- `outgoing_stats_enabled` (Boolean) Whether outgoing statistics are enabled.
- `outgoing_syncs_enabled` (Boolean) Whether outgoing syncs are enabled on this site.
- `remote_user` (String) Remote user stored by VergeOS.
- `repairs_outgoing_enabled` (Boolean) Whether outgoing repairs are enabled.
- `site_id` (String) SHA1 id of the remote system.
- `status` (String) Current site status.
- `status_info` (String) Detail for status.
- `vsan_host` (String) vSAN host reported for this site.
- `vsan_port` (Number) vSAN port reported for this site.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The `terraform import` command can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import vergeio_site.example <site_key>
```
